title: About how many words are in a book with two hundred pages?
description: Kavya picks up a thick storybook in her school library. The video counts the words on a small part and uses it again and again.
teaching_notes: One idea: count a small part, then use it for every part. Watch for children who add the pages and the words on a page.

source: A book has around 200 pages and each page has about 50 words
video_script.why: The child has met 5-digit distances and now asks where else such big counts appear around us.
video_script.substitution: Count one small part, use it for ten and a hundred parts, then double to reach the whole.
video_script.anchor: Kavya's thick storybook in the school library in Bengaluru
video_script.wrong_move: Chintu adds the pages and the words on a page. Each of the two hundred pages has fifty words of its own, so the words are many groups of fifty.
video_script.payoff_line: the book has about ten thousand words

final_answer.spoken: about ten thousand words, a five digit number

maths_rules: book: about 200 pages, about 50 words on each page
200 pages are 2 times as many as 100 pages: 5,000 × 2 = 10,000 words
10,000 has 5 digits (1 and four 0s); a 5 digit number starts at 10,000
slip: 200 + 50 = 250 adds pages to words; it is far too small, since one hundred pages alone hold 5,000 words
your turn: 60 pages, about 200 words a page: 60 × 200 = 12,000 words; never shown
video_script.design: One idea: count a small part, then use it for every part. Wrong idea: add the pages and the words on a page. The book stays in the anchor band; the page blocks build on the stage.

beats.on_screen: a photo of the school library sits behind as a dimmed backdrop and fades at the end of the beat; a small title card From your book; a thick storybook; a marker reads about 200 pages and about 50 words on each page; an empty box asks about how many words

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Kavya picks up a thick storybook in her school library in Bengaluru.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>It has around two hundred pages.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Each page has about fifty words.
<bookmark mark='m5'/>About how many words are in the whole book?

marks.m7: the book shrinks to one page
marks.m8: one page block marked 50 words appears
marks.m10: a stack of 10 pages marked 500 words appears
marks.m11: a stack of 100 pages marked 5,000 words appears

narration: <bookmark mark='m7'/>We do not need to count every single word in the book.
<bookmark mark='m8'/>Count one small part, and use it again and again.
<bookmark mark='m9'/>One page has about fifty words, and we start from that.
<bookmark mark='m10'/>Ten pages have ten times as many, which is five hundred words.
<bookmark mark='m11'/>One hundred pages have ten times that again, which is five thousand words.

marks.m14: fifty words stream out of each page
marks.m15: the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m12'/>Two hundred pages and fifty words make two hundred and fifty words.
<bookmark mark='m13'/>That cannot be right, because one hundred pages already hold five thousand words.
<bookmark mark='m14'/>Every page of the book brings fifty words of its own.
<bookmark mark='m15'/>We need many groups of fifty, one for each page.

beats.on_screen: the 100 page stack is doubled: 5,000 + 5,000 = 10,000 words; the answer card appears; the digits of 10,000 are split into five boxes

marks.m16: the 100 page stack marked 5,000 words glows

marks.m19: the answer card about 10,000 words appears

narration: <bookmark mark='m16'/>One hundred pages hold five thousand words, as we saw.
<bookmark mark='m17'/>Two hundred pages are two times as many.
<bookmark mark='m18'/>Five thousand and five thousand make ten thousand words.
<bookmark mark='m19'/>The book has about ten thousand words.

beats.on_screen: the number 10,000 splits into five digit boxes: 1, 0, 0, 0, 0; the words five digit number light up

marks.m22: the words five digit number light up

narration: <bookmark mark='m20'/>Count the digits of ten thousand.
<bookmark mark='m21'/>There is a one and four zeros, which makes five digits.
<bookmark mark='m22'/>A five digit number starts at ten thousand, so this book is a five digit count.

marks.m25: the notebook line appears with an empty box

narration: <bookmark mark='m23'/>Count a small part, then multiply by the number of parts.
<bookmark mark='m24'/>A big count can be about right without counting everything.
<bookmark mark='m25'/>Your turn. A notebook has sixty pages, and each page has about two hundred words. About how many words are in it?
